verse.text: Know the state of your flocks, and put your heart into caring for your herds,

video.title: Solving the Money Mystery | Proverbs 27:23 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: A good shepherd doesn't just own sheep — he knows them, checks on them, notices when something's off. That's the picture for us as dads: it's not enough to provide a roof and a paycheck, we have to actually know how our kids and wife are doing underneath the surface. Take five minutes tonight and really ask, then really listen — that's putting your heart into caring for your flock.
